And no one knows the past, and the future of foiling better than Fred.     This April 4th to 10th Cabarete will be your home to become a ballet dancer on your foil. Whether wing foil or kite foil, Uncharted and Fred will help you realize your foil goals.    As always everything is included in this sublime foiling experience. Uncharted Kite Sessions has a beautiful home in Uncharted Villas on the best property and accommodations on Kite Beach. Uncharted Villas are your own little slice of paradise in Cabarete with your own private bedroom and bath in luxurious accommodations right on the beach.     The pool deck at Uncharted Villas provides a wonderful vantage point to watch the action live. And for our videographer Cabarete Photos, it is the perfect location to set up their tripod to capture all your highlights for our daily video coaching sessions.    The food is incredible, catered daily from our in-house private chef CabaEats. As we are all staying in the same location, meals are quick and easy, and our chef creates an incredible menu to satiate all our starving kiters during the camp.    We know that no two riders are the same, and every kiter has specific needs based on their riding level. Even though this is a ‘foil camp’ with multiple riders, each guest receives custom coaching to their individual desires, skills and foiling goals. We ride with each guest one on one to insure tailor made coaching just for you. You’ll ride on the water with Fred always in clear communication via bbTalkin two-way bluetooth headsets. Fred and Uncharted will walk you through step by step any maneuver you want, while explaining it in real time, crystal clear in your ears from the excellent bluetooth technology. Combine the on the water live instruction with the daily video review, your skills are guaranteed to skyrocket.    Cabarete is the hometown for Uncharted Kite Sessions due to its reliable and varied conditions. Our bay is a foilers paradise with flat water on the inside, and foil safe waves over the reef on the outside. Catching waves or mastering your upwind tack, our playground is a foilers dream.    Cabarete this April will be home to one of the best foilers on the planet for an exceptional five day foil camp aiming to improve riding technique for all levels of riders who are passionate about foiling, want to improve their skills, and desire to learn from the best. Join Fred Hope, the most talented foiler in the world to perfect every aspect of your foiling.    Sign up today!"

    <article class="uk-article">
        <div class="image">
    		<img src="/media/k2/items/cache/63ae8dd535459e6ddaa9950601158f8d_XL.jpg" alt="Fred Hope Foil Master 2027">
    	</div>
        <div class="title uk-margin-large-top">
            <h1 class="uk-article-title">Fred Hope Foil Master 2027</h1>
        </div>
        <dl class="uk-description-list-horizontal uk-align-center uk-margin-large-top uk-width-medium-3-4 uk-text-large">
                        <dt class="dates">Dates:</dt>
            <dd class="dates">April 4th to 10th, 2027</dd>
                        <dt class="number-of-guests">Number Of Guests:</dt>
            <dd class="number-of-guests">Only 6</dd>
                        <dt class="price">Price:</dt>
            <dd class="price">$4800 USD</dd>
                        <dt class="pro">Camp Pro:</dt>
            <dd class="pro"><a class="uk-button uk-button-link" href="/">Fred Hope</a></dd>
            <!--            <dt class="location">Camp Location:</dt>
            <dd class="location"><a class="uk-button uk-button-link" href="/">Cabarete, Dominican Republic</a></dd>
            -->
        </dl>
                    <p><iframe class="uk-responsive-width" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/gSD1qgG2M1A" width="1280" height="720" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen=""></iframe></p>
                <div class="introtext uk-margin-large-top">
            <p>    This will be the 7th edition of our Foil Masters week with world champion Fred Hope in Cabarete, and we are just as excited about number seven as we were for number one. We keep doing camps with Fred because it is an amazing experience that always delivers incredible progress for those who love to foil. Foiling has evolved much more than anyone could have ever imagined. Now one's foil options are limitless. And no one knows the past, and the future of foiling better than Fred. <br />    This April 4th to 10th Cabarete will be your home to become a ballet dancer on your foil. Whether wing foil or kite foil, Uncharted and Fred will help you realize your foil goals.<br />    As always everything is included in this sublime foiling experience. Uncharted Kite Sessions has a beautiful home in Uncharted Villas on the best property and accommodations on Kite Beach. Uncharted Villas are your own little slice of paradise in Cabarete with your own private bedroom and bath in luxurious accommodations right on the beach. <br />    The pool deck at Uncharted Villas provides a wonderful vantage point to watch the action live. And for our videographer Cabarete Photos, it is the perfect location to set up their tripod to capture all your highlights for our daily video coaching sessions.<br />    The food is incredible, catered daily from our in-house private chef CabaEats. As we are all staying in the same location, meals are quick and easy, and our chef creates an incredible menu to satiate all our starving kiters during the camp.<br />    We know that no two riders are the same, and every kiter has specific needs based on their riding level. Even though this is a ‘foil camp’ with multiple riders, each guest receives custom coaching to their individual desires, skills and foiling goals. We ride with each guest one on one to insure tailor made coaching just for you. You’ll ride on the water with Fred always in clear communication via bbTalkin two-way bluetooth headsets. Fred and Uncharted will walk you through step by step any maneuver you want, while explaining it in real time, crystal clear in your ears from the excellent bluetooth technology. Combine the on the water live instruction with the daily video review, your skills are guaranteed to skyrocket.<br />    Cabarete is the hometown for Uncharted Kite Sessions due to its reliable and varied conditions. Our bay is a foilers paradise with flat water on the inside, and foil safe waves over the reef on the outside. Catching waves or mastering your upwind tack, our playground is a foilers dream.<br />    Cabarete this April will be home to one of the best foilers on the planet for an exceptional five day foil camp aiming to improve riding technique for all levels of riders who are passionate about foiling, want to improve their skills, and desire to learn from the best. Join Fred Hope, the most talented foiler in the world to perfect every aspect of your foiling.<br />    Sign up today!<br /><br /></p>        </div>
                <div class="fulltext">
                    </div>
                <div class="image one uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/Hope27/Fred_Hope_2027_Banner_3.jpg" alt="Fred Hope Foil Master 2027" />
        </div>
                <div class="package-includes uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Package Includes</h4>
            <p><strong>    •    </strong>6 night accommodations at Uncharted Villas ocean front villas.<br />    •    5 days of coaching with World Champion Fred Hope and Uncharted Kite Sessions.<br />    •    Private Chef<br />    •    All food and drinks with an incredible varied daily menu. <br />    •    5 Day structured coaching program.<br />    •    bbTalkin 2-way bluetooth headsets during coaching.<br />    •    Advanced kite-flying course.<br />    •    All local transport during camp.<br />    •    Professional photography &amp; video. We have professional camera crew Cabarete Photos joining the camp that will shoot photo and video that will be used in the coaching program. A complete personalized video is available for purchase for $175 USD.<br />    •    Water and snacks between coaching sessions.<br />    •    Demo of Slingshot kite gear. </p>
<p><strong><br />About Your Accommodations at Uncharted Villas<br /></strong>    Each guest will enjoy 6 nights accommodation at Uncharted Villas with their own private bedroom and bathroom located on Kite Beach. With only a handful of units, this small oceanfront hotel residences offers the convenience of direct beach access for our camp, spacious bedrooms, central air conditioning, spacious living rooms, flat screen televisions, large ocean view balconies that face the open Atlantic ocean, lush gardens, elevators, 24 hour security, and a beachfront pool with breathtaking ocean views that will astound.<br />    Please check out our selection of gorgeous villas here:<br /><strong><a href="/uncharted-villas">https://www.unchartedkitesessions.com/uncharted-villas</a></strong></p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="eating uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Eating</h4>
            <p>    As always all meals are included as this is very much part of the experience. A lot of information gets passed at meals, and you actually get to know Fred off the water in a more relaxed environment. One of the most enjoyed parts of every camp has been the fantastic food. With a background in fine dining, Uncharted founder Andreas believes amazing food is the best way to cap off an incredible day on the water. Whether the giant bowl of fresh calamari &amp; shrimp; a brilliant tuna tartar; or the sumptuous Angus steak perfectly prepared on the bbq, the food is exquisite, and the friendships that are made while breaking bread last beyond the days of the camp.</p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="not-included uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Not Included</h4>
            <p>Personal expenses, local gratuities, personal video, airport transfer and airfare.</p>        </div>
                <div class="flight-info uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Flight Info</h4>
            <p>To get to Cabarete there are several different flight options. <br />The best option is Puerto Plata (POP). It is a smaller airport, but there are daily flights from Miami, New York and Europe. It is a 30 minute taxi and flat rate of $40 USD. <br />The second best option is Santiago (STI). STI is a large city and has more flight options. It is a 90 minute taxi and flat rate of $100 USD. It is a very common option.  <br />Third option is Juan Bosch (AZS) in Nagua. It is a 2.5 hour drive and a flat rate of $150. Not as many flight options as STI. <br />Final option is the capital Santo Domingo (SDQ). At 6 million people, they have many direct global arrivals. It is a 3.5/4 hour drive and a $250 flat rate. You literally cross the entire country from south to north. <br />Uncharted Kite Sessions has a very good drivers who can pick you up and drop you at our villas safely. They can retrieve you from any airport you desire to arrive.</p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="image two uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/Hope27/Fred_Hope_2027_Banner_4.jpg" alt="Fred Hope Foil Master 2027" />
        </div>
                <div class="wind-and-climate uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Strength Of Wind</h4>
            <p>    April is statistically a great month for wind in Cabarete with average daily winds ranging around fifteen to twenty knots. For foiling most people ride from 4m to 9m kites depending on weight. But as it is Mother Nature, and she is unpredictable, it is better to have a kite and not need it, than to need a kite and not have it.</p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="wind-and-climate uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Wind &amp; Climate</h4>
            <p>   With an average temperature of 28°C (80°F) in the spring, Cabarete is the perfect choice for this foil camp series as the wind is extremely consistent due its thermal effect. The wind is predominantly from the east, as is the swell. Cabarete is consistently rated as one of the best kite destinations in the world for a reason. With access to excellent flat water oases, beautiful beach breaks, and perfect barrels over the reef, it’s obvious why we chose to make Cabarete our destination choice for our annual camp with Fred. Join Uncharted Kite Sessions and Fred Hope this April in Cabarete and reach your true foiling potential.</p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                	<div class="wind-and-climate uk-text-center uk-margin-top">
                <iframe class="uk-responsive-width" width="650" height="450" src="https://embed.windy.com/embed2.html?lat=19.842&lon=-70.409&zoom=10&level=surface&overlay=wind&menu=true&message=&marker=true&forecast=12&calendar=now&location=coordinates&type=map&actualGrid=&metricWind=kt&metricTemp=%C2%B0C" frameborder="0"></iframe>
            </div>
                <div class="gear uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Do You Need Your Own Gear?</h4>
            <p>   Yes. UKS will have some Slingshot gear for demo, but in limited quantities. Water shoes are also a good idea if you're a beginner surfer planning a surf morning at Encuentro.</p>        </div>
                <div class="more-details uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">More Details</h4>
            <p>   Uncharted Kite Sessions focuses on professional instruction on how to improve riding skills, but also integrates cultural immersion into our camps. We have video analysis to adjust your stance, kite and board position. We have an advanced kite-flying lesson that teaches you the finer points of kite control. We teach looping, self launching nod landing, luff recovery, and so much more. We use bbTalkin two way blue tooth headsets for on the water coaching so all instructions are clearly understood.</p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="image three uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/Hope27/Fred_Hope_2027_Banner_21.jpg" alt="Fred Hope Foil Master 2027" />
        </div>
